messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Conditional tabsetPanels
parts:
I'm trying to create different tabs based on a variable from sidebarPanel.  I thought something like below would work in the mainPanel but it places the second set of panels underneath the first set and nothing runs from server.R.   Thanks for all the help.

 sidebarPanel(
  selectInput("Page", "Method",list('One'=1,'Two'=2),selected=1),
)

mainPanel(

conditionalPanel(condition="input.Page==1",
  tabsetPanel(
     tabPanel("Data", plotOutput("basicPlot",width = "800px", height = "600px"),value=1), 
     tabPanel("boot", verbatimTextOutput("boot"),value=2),id='panel'
    )),

conditionalPanel(condition="input.Page==2",
     tabsetPanel(
       tabPanel("Data2", plotOutput("basicPlot2",width = "800px", height = "600px"),value=1), 
       tabPanel("boot2", verbatimTextOutput("boot2"),value=2),id='panel2'
     ))
  
)

messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Re: Conditional tabsetPanels
parts:
I got it to work.  I cannot use the same functions in both tabsets (basicPlot and boot).  In my actual code they were the same.

Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Conditional tabsetPanels
parts: Yep, that's right, the input and output IDs need to be unique. conditionalPanels just hide their contents--those controls all still exist and thus can't have duplicate IDs.
